methodologyNotes: Covers standalone wired Ethernet network switches (desktop or rackmount) for home, prosumer, and SMB use, sold at a published US price. Excludes Wi-Fi routers, wireless access points, media converters, DAC/transceiver accessories, and modular chassis line cards. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. totalPorts is the count of data ports (RJ45 plus SFP/SFP+ cages), excluding any dedicated console or out-of-band management port. maxPortSpeedGbps is the fastest single-port line rate in Gbps (e.g. 1, 2.5, 10). multiGigPorts is the number of copper RJ45 ports rated 2.5G or faster; 0 if every RJ45 port is 1G. sfpPlusPorts is the number of 10G-capable SFP+ fiber/uplink cages (a 10G-capable RJ45/SFP+ combo cage is counted here). switchingCapacityGbps is the total non-blocking switching-fabric bandwidth in Gbps per the manufacturer datasheet. forwardingRateMpps is the packet forwarding rate in million packets per second at 64-byte frames. managementType is one of: unmanaged, smart-web-managed, L2-managed, L3-managed. poeStandard is the highest Power-over-Ethernet class supported: none, PoE (802.3af), PoE+ (802.3at), or PoE++ (802.3bt). poeBudgetWatts is the total PoE power budget in watts across all ports; 0 if the switch has no PoE. macTableSize is the MAC address table capacity in entries. fanless is a boolean, true if the switch is passively cooled with no fan. powerConsumptionWatts is the maximum system power draw in watts excluding delivered PoE load, per datasheet.
